about.general: I'm Adhira (uh-DEER-ah). I build AI products and shape the strategy that scales them, and I understand both from the model architecture up to the business case. For clients, that means I can set the AI direction, prototype the system, lead the team that ships it, and make the case for why it matters to the business. I do this at scale, and I care most about pointing AI at hard, high-stakes problems, in healthcare, the public sector, and the way knowledge work gets done.
about.currentRole:
Today I'm a **Tech & AI Business Analyst at McKinsey & Company**, where I shape AI and GenAI strategy and help clients turn ambiguous problems into AI systems that ship and get measured.

Before McKinsey, I was a **Product Manager and Lead AI Developer at Deloitte** (Defense AI & Engineering). I led a seven-person team building secure retrieval-augmented generation products on NVIDIA DGX, shipped a federal AI chatbot now serving **40,000+ users**, and earned four performance awards.

Earlier, I engineered Kindle features at **Amazon**, worked AI strategy as a summer analyst at **Deloitte**, built full-stack systems at **Cognosos**, and ran machine-learning research at the **CLAWS Lab at Georgia Tech**.
about.education:
I earned a **B.S. in Computer Science with Highest Honors from Georgia Tech**, specializing in **Artificial Intelligence and Human-Computer Interaction**, and I finished the degree in **two years, at 19**. I served as **Executive VP of AI for Medicine & Healthcare (AIMS)** and led Big Data Big Impact projects on **job-scam detection** and **medical imaging**.

My hackathon record includes award-winning work at **AI ATL**, sponsored by Google, BCG, and Anthropic.
about.techStack: Python, C++, React, AWS, NVIDIA hardware, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, and NumPy. I build AI systems that hold up in production: secure, evaluated, and tied to a real outcome.

workExperience.desc: - Shape AI and ML strategy, then lead delivery, taking GenAI and agentic AI from concept through testing, rollout, and measured business impact.

workExperience.position: Product Manager & Lead AI Developer – Defense AI & Engineering
workExperience.desc:
- Led a seven-person team building a secure, isolated retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) product on open-source LLMs in a siloed NVIDIA DGX environment.
- Shipped a federal client's first production AI chatbot, now serving 40,000+ users, owning AI and backend development.
- Owned system architecture and data flow, and wrote both the user-facing and technical documentation through deployment and stakeholder demos.
- Advanced the firm's AI work in bioinformatics and federal health through publications, events, and internal eminence.
- Earned four performance awards (two Shout Out Awards, an Applause Award, and an Outstanding Performance Award) for innovation, delivery, and team leadership.

- Built and shipped two Kindle features in C++ and React Native on the ReadON team, improving navigation and the customer experience.
- Created reusable components that cut development time 20%, with unit tests reaching 90% coverage.
- Added AWS CloudWatch monitoring and Hydra integration testing to harden system performance.

- Supported AI growth across government and public-sector accounts.
- Built generative AI chatbots for health and education departments on BART transformer models.
- Created a generative-AI analytics dashboard and co-authored the firm's AI playbook and training.

- Improved API modularity and wrote 85+ Swagger documentation entries.
- Raised application performance 25% with AWS EC2 and scalable infrastructure.
- Shipped sprint work under Agile as requirements shifted.

- Built a web app connected to a multimodal ML model to study adversarial effects on classification.
- Ran a user experiment and statistical analysis to find vulnerabilities and improve model performance.
- Built a dashboard visualizing model performance with responsive web technologies.

projects.title: Partnr - Consulting Co-Pilot
projects.des: A generative-AI consulting co-pilot, fine-tuned on meetings and emails, that lets consultants and executives work through client context faster. First place at AI ATL.

projects.title: BloodSight AI - Medical Technology Solution
projects.des: Turns blood work and patient data into predictive, preventive health insights for patients and physicians. Recognized through Georgia Tech's Create-X / I2P program.

projects.title: Seed: Returns Meet Responsibility
projects.des: An investing platform that pairs financial returns with social impact, so investors can act on both at the same time.

projects.title: van.Go - Custom AI Painting Tutorials
projects.des: Generates a painting from a prompt, then overlays step-by-step visual instructions for an interactive, multimodal painting tutorial.

projects.title: tAI: Your AI Teaching Assistant
projects.des: A personalized AI teaching assistant: multimodal, empathetic support for students, plus engagement and learning analytics for professors.

projects.title: Detecting & Locating Findings in ML Screening Mammograms

projects.title: Data Analysis of Adversarial Attacks on Multimodal Models
projects.des: Studied how adversarial attacks affect multimodal classification, with a web app that collected and analyzed 85,000+ tweets.

projects.title: LEAP Foundation: Leveraging Education & Academics for the Poor
projects.des: Led this education nonprofit for four years to widen access to schooling in India: 90+ volunteers, $900+ raised, $2,000+ in donated supplies, and 300+ children reached across five academic projects and two partnerships.
